label: 5. I'm sorry for contacting you so often.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I'm sorry for contacting you so often.
It's okay.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I have another favor to ask of you.
What is it this time?

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I was servicing the weapon today,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: and discovered that some parts are damaged.
Weapon? Are you talking about Seven Dwarves?

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Correct!

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: You understand perfectly.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Very impressive.
You say it needs fixing?

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I borrowed this weapon.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: It was not mine originally.
Yes, I remember. You said it belongs to Snow White.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I'm borrowing it out of necessity right now,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: but I intend to give it back.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: To that end,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I store it in an airtight container whenever possible,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: as I want to return it to its original owner in the best possible condition.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: However,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I used it a lot during this last skirmish with Behemoth,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: and as a result, some parts inside the container got damaged!!
Wow! You're so surprised that you're even using exclamation marks? Hahaha.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I was surprised!

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I didn't intend for that to happen,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: but it did.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: At any rate, I need to repair those damaged components.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I've collected some spare parts for that purpose.
You've already gathered the parts you need?

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I originally intended on giving them to Snow White,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: but I didn't run into her at all.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Instead, I found myself face-to-face with a Heretic.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I couldn't lose Cinderella, and so I had to use Seven Dwarves.
Ah, so you were using Seven Dwarves while fighting Behemoth.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Mm.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I had no choice.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I have felt intense remorse ever since.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: For a while now,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I've gathered spare parts precisely for this sort of potentiality.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I collected them while searching for Cinderella's medical equipment.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Would you like to come with me

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: to where those parts are stored?
Sure, we can go together.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Thank you!
